The two independent networks agreeing on 'extremely severe' is some cross-check evidence this isn't a single-sensor glitch, but 1372.89 as a 24-HOUR MEAN is implausibly high even for a severe fire episode and should be treated with real caution - either a genuine catastrophic local event today, or reference-grade optical/beta-attenuation instruments saturating or drifting at very high concentration (a known failure mode). Recommend the app show a capped/range value with a data-quality note rather than the raw number if this recurs, and flag for a human check before trusting it as a headline figure.
